## 入学条件 {#admissions}

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>A-level及GCSE要求：</strong>Required subjects A level grades BBB/ABC, 包括 maths及physics if taken Excluded subjects General studies, critical studies, citizenship studies, global perspectives及research, thinking skills GCSEs GCSE maths grade 6 (B); GCSE physics grade 5 (B) 或 GCSE science grade 5 (B)及GCSE additional science grade 5 (B); GCSE 英语 grade 4 (C)</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-p-UKENR-23ce30b99f95af">官方依据</a></p>

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>IB要求：</strong>IB score 28 分 总分 或 555：3 HL certificates IB requirements Minimum 4：maths及physics if taken：standard 或 HL</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-p-UKENR-23ce30b99f95af">官方依据</a></p>
